# Oriol Morros Vilaseca

> Personal website of Oriol Morros, a software engineer in London building infrastructure for AI agents at Eli by Techbible. BSc Software Engineering with First-Class Honours from ARU Cambridge. Grew up in Manresa, near Barcelona, moved to England in 2023.

## Facts

- Full name: Oriol Morros Vilaseca. Goes by Oriol Morros.
- Software Engineer at Eli by Techbible in London (2026–present), building infrastructure for AI agents to manage SaaS and payments.
- BSc (Hons) Software Engineering, First-Class Honours, Anglia Ruskin University Cambridge (2023–2026), completed while playing as a basketball scholarship athlete.
- Previously: Digital Technician at the University of Cambridge (Apr 2025–Jun 2026); rebuilt the Festival Sant Fruitós website on Next.js (Feb–Apr 2026); 18 merged pull requests in IBM MCP Context Forge, IBM's open source gateway for the Model Context Protocol (Feb–Apr 2026).
- Hackathon record (London, 2026): TrueVoice, overall winner at Voice AI Hack; WILDSCAN, overall winner at the Unicorn Mafia × Techbible hack night; OffBabel, Cosine and ExoLabs track winner at the On-Device Agent Hackathon; Basket, track winner at Tokens LDN Multi-Agent Hackathon; DarkFleet, 6th of 64 at the Claude Hackathon at Imperial College London.
- Before software (2020–2023): grew the Spanish-language TikTok account @uriisss_ to 1.5 million followers and almost 40 million likes, with 86 million video views in the best month, then built e-commerce businesses with influencers in Spain.
- Basketball: seven years in the youth academy of Bàsquet Manresa (ACB club, now BAXI Manresa), competed in Catalan and Spanish national championships and the Minicopa Endesa; scholarship athlete at university in England.
- From Manresa, Catalonia, Spain (2005–2023); Cambridge, England (2023–2026); London (2026–present).
